user_saw: The Agents Skills panel could show “No skills found” when the query and an installed skill name used different Unicode forms of the same spelling.
summary: The Agents Skills filter now NFC-normalizes both the lowercased query and searchable skill text before matching.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already lowercased the query and skill text before calling `.includes()` without Unicode normalization. The later UI moves and caching changes preserved that comparison. The offline history lookup failed on a missing pre-graft commit, so I could not verify whether the original filter shipped with this behavior or an earlier change introduced it.
